meta._format_note: Structured strength prescriptions (migration 0011). quantity/quantity_unit are DERIVED by import-workouts.mjs from sets and reps and must not be authored here.
meta._refiled: The four poor-recovery sessions were authored under strength_legs and strength_push. They are filed here under the maintenance families, which carry the hold rules pr_9/pr_10: completing a reduced dose earns no heavier prescription. It also keeps them out of HEAVY_LOWER_FAMILIES, which spaces strength_legs two days apart and would withdraw a recovery session from exactly the depleted athlete it exists for. The authored value is preserved on each workout as authored_workout_family.
meta.default_coaching_notes: Rest fully between working sets; the clock is not part of the prescription.
meta.express_rule: drop accessory and trunk volume first; the anchor lifts keep their sets
meta.micro_rule: the anchor lift only, at the prescribed load; no intensity compensation
